copy.tagline: 用 Python 惯用模式写出更优雅的代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Python 写代码，想应用设计模式和最佳实践
copy.tagline_en: Write more elegant Python code with idiomatic patterns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Python code and want to apply design patterns and best practices

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在编写 Python 代码时会应用 Python 特有的设计模式，如协议、数据类、上下文管理器、装饰器、异步/等待、类型提示和包组织等最佳实践。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或重构 Python 代码，特别是涉及 API 设计、异步系统、项目结构或类型安全时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 dataclass 定义一个用户数据类。
给这个函数加一个计时装饰器。
say.note: Claude 会添加 @timing 装饰器并测量执行时间。

say.text: 用 Protocol 实现一个仓库接口。
say.note: Claude 会创建结构子类型协议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies Python-specific design patterns and best practices when writing Python code, including protocols, dataclasses, context managers, decorators, async/await, type hints, and package organization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or refactor Python code, especially involving API design, async systems, project structure, or type safety.

say_en.text: Define a user dataclass with type hints.
say_en.note: Claude generates a dataclass with auto-generated methods.

say_en.text: Add a timing decorator to this function.
say_en.note: Claude adds @timing decorator to measure execution time.

say_en.text: Implement a repository interface using Protocol.
say_en.note: Claude creates a structural subtype protocol.
